# Simcad Simulation Software

> > AI-powered discrete event simulation platform for manufacturing, warehousing, healthcare, and service operations optimization.

Simcad is a comprehensive simulation software suite developed by CreateASoft that enables organizations to model, optimize, and predict outcomes across complex operational environments. The platform offers industry-specific solutions with capabilities ranging from 3D modeling and digital twins to predictive analytics and Lean Six Sigma process improvement.

## Key Topics

- Discrete Event Simulation
- Digital Twin
- AI & Machine Learning
- Process Optimization
- Manufacturing Simulation
- Warehouse Simulation
- Healthcare Simulation
- Capacity Planning
- Bottleneck Detection
- Automated Guided Vehicles (AGV)
- 3D Modeling
- Predictive Analytics
- Lean Six Sigma
- Virtual Reality

## Core Product Suite

- [Simcad Simulation Software](https://www.simulationsoftware.com): Simcad homepage: AI-powered simulation software for manufacturing, warehousing, healthcare
- [Simcad Product Overview](https://www.simulationsoftware.com/Simcad-Simulation): Simcad product overview: modeling, optimization, predictive analytics with free Lite version
- [Simcad Pro, Lite & Digital Twin Studio](https://www.simulationsoftware.com/simcad-simulation): Simcad product suite: Pro, Lite, DT digital twin with 3D modeling and data analytics

## Industry-Specific Solutions

- [Manufacturing Simulation Software](https://www.simulationsoftware.com/Simcad-Simulation/Manufacturing-Simulation): Simcad Manufacturing Simulator: production scheduling, capacity management, bottleneck analysis
- [Warehouse Simulation Software](https://www.simulationsoftware.com/Simcad-Simulation/Warehouse-Simulation): Simcad warehouse simulation for design, optimization, automation planning with WMS integration
- [Automation Simulation Software](https://www.simulationsoftware.com/Simcad-Simulation/Automation-Simulation): Simcad automation simulator: assembly line modeling, AGV optimization, PLC control testing
- [Healthcare Simulation Software](https://www.simulationsoftware.com/Simcad-Simulation/Healthcare-Simulation): Simcad Health: patient flow optimization, emergency department, operating room scheduling
- [Food & Beverage Simulation Software](https://www.simulationsoftware.com/Simcad-Simulation/Food-Beverage-Simulation): Simcad Process Simulator for food/beverage production optimization and OEE improvement
- [Service Simulation Software](https://www.simulationsoftware.com/Simcad-Simulation/Service-Simulation): Simcad service simulation with Lean metrics, call center optimization, discrete event simulation
